recipes.d: Soft wraps with spiced chicken and sweet potato
steps: Peel and cut sweet potatoes into small cubes and roast at 210°C (190°C fan) until tender.
Dice chicken and fry with paprika until thoroughly cooked.
Warm the wraps and wash and shred the lettuce.
Fill wraps with chicken, sweet potatoes, lettuce and a little yoghurt.

recipes.d: A filling ham, mushroom and cheddar omelette
steps: Slice mushrooms and fry until soft and their moisture has evaporated.
Beat eggs with milk, then pour half into a non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Add half the ham, mushrooms and grated cheese, then fold once the egg has set.
Repeat with the remaining mixture and cook until the eggs are completely set.

recipes.d: A simple buttery pea pasta with lemon
steps: Cook pasta in boiling water following packet instructions.
Add peas during the final few minutes of cooking, then drain and reserve a little pasta water.
Stir butter, lemon juice and grated parmesan through the hot pasta.
Loosen with pasta water if needed and serve immediately.

recipes.d: One-pan tomato rice with crumbled feta
steps: Finely chop the onion and soften in a wide pan.
Stir through rice and chopped tomatoes and add enough water to cook rice according to its packet.
Simmer, stirring and topping up with water until rice is tender, then stir in spinach until wilted.
Crumble over feta and serve hot.

recipes.d: Homemade chicken patties with crunchy salad and potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 210°C (190°C fan), cut potatoes into wedges and roast until tender and browned.
Mix chicken mince with garlic granules and shape into small, even patties.
Fry the patties until completely cooked through and no pink remains.
Serve with washed lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes and the wedges.

recipes.d: Flaked salmon with leeks and noodles in a light sauce
steps: Cook noodles according to the packet directions and drain.
Pan-cook salmon until fully cooked and flaking, then check for bones and remove skin.
Soften sliced leeks, stir in cream cheese and milk to form sauce.
Flake salmon into the sauce, add noodles and warm through gently.

recipes.d: Warm pittas filled with chickpeas and tomato pesto
steps: Drain and rinse chickpeas and warm gently in a saucepan.
Stir through red pesto, checking the chickpeas are piping hot.
Warm the pittas and chop the cucumber and spinach.
Fill the pittas with chickpeas and fresh vegetables and serve.

recipes.d: Poached eggs in a thick lentil tomato sauce
steps: Soften chopped onion with smoked paprika in a wide pan.
Add drained cooked lentils and passata and simmer until thick and hot.
Make eight hollows, crack an egg into each and cover the pan.
Cook until whites are completely set, then serve; fully cook yolks where needed.

recipes.d: Warm BBQ tofu with peppers and salad
steps: Dice tofu into small cubes and fry until golden.
Add sliced peppers and grated carrot and cook until tender.
Stir through BBQ sauce and heat until the tofu and vegetables are piping hot.
Warm the wraps and fill with tofu mixture and washed lettuce.

recipes.d: New-style potato and tuna salad with green beans
steps: Cut potatoes into even pieces and boil until tender.
Trim green beans and cook thoroughly until tender.
Drain tuna and slice spring onions, then whisk lemon juice with olive oil.
Toss the warm potatoes and beans with tuna and dressing and serve.

recipes.d: Baked crisp tortilla rounds with bean topping
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and cut small rounds or wedges from wraps.
Bake tortilla pieces until crisp and lightly golden, watching closely.
Mash drained beans with passata and warm with sweetcorn and chopped peppers until piping hot.
Spoon onto crisp tortillas, top with cheese and warm briefly to melt.

recipes.d: Warm chicken noodles with crisp cucumber and lime
steps: Cook rice noodles as directed, drain and keep warm.
Dice chicken and stir-fry until completely cooked throughout.
Grate carrots and cut cucumber into thin strips.
Toss warm noodles and chicken with vegetables, lime juice and soy and serve immediately.

recipes.d: Beef mince, cabbage and rice in one pan
steps: Cook rice as directed and use promptly while hot, or cool rapidly if preparing ahead.
Brown beef mince completely with grated ginger.
Add shredded cabbage and carrots and stir-fry until tender.
Add rice and soy sauce, cook until piping hot and serve.

recipes.d: Quick tomato pasta with spinach and melted mozzarella
steps: Boil fusilli according to the packet instructions.
Warm passata and chopped garlic in a saucepan until gently bubbling.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then toss in drained pasta.
Tear mozzarella over the pasta and stir until slightly melted; serve hot.

recipes.d: One-pan orzo with sausages and green pesto
steps: Remove sausage meat from skins if necessary, break into small pieces and cook until thoroughly done.
Add chopped onions and soften briefly.
Add orzo and enough water to cook until tender, stirring and topping up as required.
Fold in peas and pesto and heat until piping hot.

recipes.d: Crispy flatbread pizzas with feta and courgette
steps: Heat oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and thinly slice courgettes.
Spread passata over flatbreads and add courgette slices.
Scatter over crumbled feta and torn mozzarella.
Bake until the courgette is tender, the cheese golden and flatbreads crisp.

recipes.d: Flaked haddock on lemony pea couscous
steps: Cook haddock until opaque and flaking easily, checking for bones.
Cook peas until hot and prepare couscous following its packet instructions.
Fluff couscous with a fork and stir through peas, lemon juice and olive oil.
Top with flaked haddock and serve warm.

recipes.d: Black beans and rice with cool avocado and salsa
steps: Cook rice following packet directions.
Drain and rinse black beans, then warm thoroughly with salsa.
Slice avocado and chop lettuce, squeezing lime over avocado.
Fill bowls with rice and hot beans, then top with avocado and lettuce.

recipes.d: Mild creamy lentil dhal with rice
steps: Cook rice according to the packet.
Soften chopped onion with curry powder in a saucepan.
Add rinsed lentils, coconut milk and enough water to cover; simmer until lentils are completely soft, stirring often.
Fold in spinach until wilted and serve the piping-hot dhal with rice.

recipes.d: Sweet-and-savoury pork with peppers and rice
steps: Cook rice according to packet instructions.
Cut pork into small strips and stir-fry with grated ginger until thoroughly cooked.
Add sliced peppers and pineapple and stir-fry until peppers are tender.
Stir in soy sauce and serve immediately over rice.

recipes.d: Warm quinoa topped with creamy mushrooms
steps: Cook quinoa following its packet instructions and drain.
Soften chopped onions and sliced mushrooms in a pan until the mushroom liquid evaporates.
Add chopped garlic, spinach and cream cheese with a splash of water, stirring until creamy and hot.
Spoon over quinoa and serve immediately.
